summary: Scorpio Tankers Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of Class III director Marianne kland effective August 15, 2026, and the appointment of Andrea Lupo Lanzara as her replacement effective August 17, 2026. The resignation was not due to any disagreement with the Company. Mr. Lanzara is President of Accademia Costume Moda, with no family relationships or disclosable transactions. This is a routine board change, not a special situation. No deal terms, premiums, or strategic actions are present.
